subject.title: GChat: Typing indicator persists after NO_REPLY + emoji reaction

question: Should maintainers adopt or repair the open fork cleanup PR, replace it with a fresh narrow OpenClaw PR, or reject Google Chat NO_REPLY placeholder cleanup?
rationale: The bug remains source-reproducible on current main, but an open closing PR already exists outside the target repo, so duplicate autonomous fix work should wait for a maintainer path choice.

options.title: Review or replace the open cleanup PR
options.body: Use https://github.com/BingqingLyu/openclaw/pull/155 if it can be refreshed with proof, or open a narrow replacement preserving the same Google Chat lifecycle boundary.

options.title: Reject the cleanup
options.body: Close the candidate and this issue only if maintainers decide reaction-only turns should not consume the Google Chat typing placeholder.
